title: Connection Formulae for a Generalised Ramanujan Entire Function
summary: The Ramanujan$-$$q$-Airy connection formula relates the convergent series at the origin to the behaviour at infinity of the Ramanujan entire function. We extend this connection to a one-parameter deformation, which embeds the Ramanujan (second-order) $q$-difference operator in a family of third-order equations. By contour integral as $q$-Borel inversion, we give behaviour at infinity in terms of divergent local expansions with connection coefficients uniquely determined.
